title: pedicularis longiflora subsp. tubiformis
intro: Pedicularis longiflora subsp. tubiformis, commonly known as a plant species in the family Orobanchaceae, is a type of flowering plant that obtains its nutrients by parasitizing the roots of other plants. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pedicularis longiflora subsp. tubiformis may include reducing inflammation and improving immune function, although more research is needed to confirm these effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
